blocking_findings.required_fix: Remove public caller-controlled packet issuance as a publishable path. Establish exactly one issuance boundary bound to validated CalculationRequest + verified RuntimeIdentity/capability; require downstream checks to prove issuance, not merely self-consistency.
Bind trust-bearing control-plane (.github/workflows and any release/build governance files) into a separately verified control-plane identity or canonical combined identity.
Fail non-zero when computed source/control-plane identity differs from the declared manifest. CI reporting alone is insufficient.
Reject non-string subject/scope/modality/tense values before allow-list comparison; never coerce schema-invalid types.
Replace runtime_authorized: bool with a verified authority capability/receipt accepted only from the CE authority boundary.
Preserve warning_or_error deterministically into ObjectRecord warnings/errors without silent loss.
Reject NOT_ESTABLISHED and equivalent sentinel values in identity-bearing source/build fields; require exact format and semantic completeness.
Preserve contract-supported microseconds in canonical_utc; prove distinct instants cannot canonicalize to the same value unless the contract explicitly permits it.
Close all trust-bearing object maps or define explicit schemas for them; Python and JSON schema must describe the same contract.
Close CanonRule condition/confidence_language_boundary schemas to the exact supported field sets and keep schema/runtime validators aligned.

governance_invariant: No remediation branch or audit branch establishes Source Authority, Trusted Build, Runtime Adoption, Production Authorization, Dual Approval, or SEAL.
